analysis.title: UBS Macro Equity Navigator: Favorable AI Asymmetry
key_insights: After the second AI positioning unwind this year, AI positioning is cleaner but not yet washed out. The crowding score spread between the UBS AI Winners basket (UBXXAIW) and the Ex-AI 400 basket (UBXXX400) is back to February levels.
UBS says the size of the AI derating prices an overly pessimistic outlook for AI fundamentals, which skews risk-reward to the upside, though sentiment remains fragile.

Hyperscalers (UBXXHYPE) have been the preferred hiding place within AI. The Neoclouds+ basket (UBXXNEOC) sits at the center of leverage and data-center buildout concerns. UBS cites stronger operating cash flows, healthier balance sheets and ownership of existing compute capacity for the rotation.
UBS calls hyperscalers the best defensive expression for investors with less conviction on broad AI beta.

The broadening trade has largely relied on AI weakness, which leaves sectors without fundamental support for recent strength vulnerable to a correction. Consumer Staples (UBXXSTAP) still show very poor earnings revisions breadth, while Health Care looks better.
One of Keith Parker's top trades into 2027 is long XLV versus XLP.

China is attracting attention again as a portfolio diversifier, but CSI 300 vs S&P 500 earnings revisions breadth is at multi-year lows. UBS says a sustained recovery needs that line to turn up, plus more forceful policy support and a stabilized property market.

Europe: the Stoxx 600 is at new highs and has outpaced the S&P 500 by 9pp since early October. UBS attributes this to fading headwinds from rates and energy prices, and estimates only about 11% of the Stoxx 600 is materially driven by the AI enablement trade.

European Banks (UBXEBANK) earnings revisions breadth has dropped sharply after a softer Q3 season with smaller average beats and more misses. The house view stays constructive, with Gerry Fowler expecting a sustained re-rating through 2027 on valuations and rising lending growth.

Energy stocks (UBXEENER) are down 8% against Metals & Miners (UBXEMETL) over three weeks as Brent has priced out about $15-20 of risk premium. UBS says the rotation has more room to run if flows keep normalizing and a major re-escalation is avoided.
Net exposure in European Energy stocks has started to roll over but remains at the 85th percentile on a 2-year lookback, well above summer lows.

UK Domestics (UBXEUKEX) have run strongly since this summer's change in Prime Minister. Last month's Budget eased near-term fiscal worries, and growth has been resilient with AI making a rising contribution.
